data.businessDescription: SEB SA engages in the manufacturing of small domestic equipment and cookware. It operates through the Consumer and Professional segments. The Consumer segment focuses on kitchen electrics, home and personal care, and cookware. The Professional segment includes coffee machines and other professional equipment. The company was founded in 1973 and is headquartered in Écully, France.

Aryzta AG is a global food business, which engages in the development, production, and distribution of food in convenience bakery markets. It operates through the Aryzta Europe and Aryzta Rest of World geographical segments. The Aryzta Europe segment deals with the European convenience bakery market and has a diversified customer base within the food service, large retail, quick service restaurants and convenience, and independent retail channels. The Aryzta Rest of World segment consists of businesses in Japan, Malaysia, Singapore, Taiwan, Australia, and New Zealand, primarily partnering with international quick service restaurants and other food service customers. The company was founded in 1988 and is headquartered in Schlieren, Switzerland.

CIE Automotive SA engages in the design, manufacture, and sale of automotive components and sub-assemblies for the global automotive market. It operates through the following geographical segments: North America, Brazil, Asia, Mahindra CIE Europe, and Rest of Europe. The North America Segment includes basically group companies in Mexico and United States. The Brazil segment consists of group companies located in Brazil. The Asia segment covers the Indian companies of the Mahindra CIE group, as well as the companies located in the People's Republic of China. The Mahindra CIE Europe segment represents the business for the manufacture of European forges, dependent on the Mahindra CIE group. The Rest of Europe segment comprises of all non-dependent of Mahindra CIE subgroup manufacturing businesses basically located in Europe. The company was founded on April 13, 1939 and is headquartered in Bilbao, Spain.

Unibail-Rodamco-Westfield SE engages in the development and operation of flagship destinations. It operates through the following business segments: Shopping Centres, Offices and Others, and Convention and Exhibition. The Shopping Centres segment operates and leases shopping centers. The Offices and Others segment develops and owns office buildings and hotels. The Convention and Exhibition segment includes real estate venues rental and services company. The company was founded on July 23, 1968 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

ID Logistics Group engages in the provision of contract logistics services. It offers warehousing and transportation optimization solutions, and value-added services like packaging, cross-docking, and quality control. It operates in the following sectors: dry food, general non-food, fresh produce, electronics-high technology, cosmetics, beverages, fashion and electronic business. The company was founded by Eric Hémar and Christophe Satin on September 12, 2001 and is headquartered in Orgon, France.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Logistics and Supply Chain Service Providers

data.businessDescription: Altarea SCA engages in the real estate development industry. It operates through the following segments: Retail, Residential, Business Property, New Businesse and Others. The Retail segment includes shopping centres under management or under development. The Residential segment offers residential property development. The Business Property offers property development, services and investment business. The New Businesse segment is involved in real estate asset management. The company was founded by Alain Taravella and Jacques Nicolet in 1994 and is headquartered in Paris, France.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Other Real Estate Investment and Services

data.businessDescription: Bouygues SA provides constructions for building, civil works, energy and services, property, roads and coals. The firm operates through the following segments: Bouygues Construction (Construction & Services), Bouygues Immobilier (Property), Colas (Transport Infrastructure), TF1 (Media) and Bouygues Telecom (Telecoms). The company was founded by Francis Bouygues in 1952 and is headquartered in Paris, France.

H. Lundbeck A/S engages in the research, development, production, and sale of pharmaceuticals for the treatment of psychiatric and neurological disorders. Its product portfolio targets the following diseases: Alzheimer's, depression, Parkinson's, Schizophrenia, alcohol dependence, anxiety, bipolar disorder, epilepsy, and Huntington's. It operates through the following geographical segments: Europe, United States, and International Operations. The company was founded by Hans Lundbeck on August 14, 1915 and is headquartered in Valby, Denmark.

HVPE provides a complete private markets solution for public investors by investing in primary funds, secondary investments, and direct co-investments to provide shareholders with superior, long-term capital growth.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Asset Management and Financial Advisory Services

data.businessDescription: Okeanis Eco Tankers Corp. is a holding company, which engages in the ownership and operation of commercial shipping vessels. Its activities include the transportation of crude oil, refined oil products, and other liquid products. The firm's portfolio includes Very Large Crude Carriers, Suezmax, and Aframax. The company was founded on April 30, 2018 and is headquartered in Piraeus, Greece.
data.rbicsSubsectorClassification: Support Activities for Oil and Gas Operations
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Oil and Gas Transportation and Infrastructure

data.businessDescription: Cirsa Enterprises SAU is a real estate company. It is engaged in the acquisition, promotion and rehabilitation of real estate property. The company was founded on November 15, 2017 and is headquartered in Madrid, Spain.

Adecco Group AG is a talent advisory and solutions company, which engages in human capital solutions including flexible placement, permanent placement, career transition, outsourcing, consulting, training, up-/re-skilling, and other services. It operates through the following geographical segments: Adecco France, Adecco Northern Europe, Adecco DACH, Adecco Southern Europe and EEMENA, Adecco Americas, Adecco APAC, Adecco, Akkodis, and LHH. The company was founded by Henri Lavanchy in 1957 and is headquartered in Zurich, Switzerland.

Ithaca Energy Plc is a holding company that engages in the exploration, development, and production of oil and gas. It primarily focuses in the properties in the North Sea area. The company was founded in 2004 and is headquartered in Aberdeen, the United Kingdom.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Other Fossil Fuel Exploration and Production

data.businessDescription: KSB SE & Co. KGaA engages in the manufacture of industrial and building pumps, valves, and related systems. It operates through the following segments: Pumps, Valves, and KSB SupremeServ. The Pumps segment covers single and multistage pumps, submersible pumps, and associated control and drive systems. The Valves segment includes butterfly, globe, gate, control, diaphragm and ball valves, and associate actuators and control systems. The KSB SupremeServ Segment is composed of installation, commissioning, inspection, servicing,maintenance, reverse engineering and repair of pumps, related systems and valves, as well as modular service concepts and system analyses for complete plants. The company was founded by Johannes Klein, Friedrich Schanzlin, and Jakob Becker in 1871 and is headquartered in Frankenthal, Germany.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Air, Liquid and Gas Control Equipment

data.businessDescription: Alvotech is a biotechnology company, which engages in the development and manufacture of biosimilar medicines. The firm is focusing on the development of its product candidates. It operates through the following geographical segments: Europe, North America, Asia, and Other. The company was founded by Róbert Vilhelm Wessman in 2013 and is headquartered in Luxembourg.
Man Group Plc operates as a holding company. It provides investment management services. The company was founded in 1783 and is headquartered in St. Helier, Jersey.
data.rbicsIndustryGroupClassification: Asset Management and Financial Advisory Services

data.businessDescription: ITV Plc engages in the production and broadcasting services. It operates through the Broadcast & Online, and ITV Studios segments. The Broadcast & Online segment offers commercial family of channels and delivers content through traditional television broadcasting. The ITV Studios segment creates and produces programs and formats that return and travel, namely drama, entertainment, and factual entertainment. The company was founded in September 1955 and is headquartered in London, the United Kingdom.

JD Sports Fashion Plc operates as a global omnichannel retailer specializing in sports fashion and outdoor apparel, footwear, and accessories. The company offers a wide portfolio of own-brand and international branded products and serves customers through an integrated network of physical stores, e-commerce platforms, and mobile channels. It operates through the following segments: JD, Complementary Athleisure, and Sporting Goods and Outdoors. The JD segment refers to JD stores which provide the latest products from global brands. The Complementary Athleisure segment include Hibbett, DTLR, and Shoe Palace in North America, together with MIG and Courir in Europe. The Sporting Goods and Outdoors segment relates to ISRG (Sprinter in Spain and Sport Zone in Portugal) and Cosmos (Greece and Cyprus), while its outdoor businesses in the UK include Outdoors, Blacks, and Millets. The entity also operates through the following geographical segments: JD UK, JD, Europe, JD North America, and JD Asia Pacific. The company was founded by John Carruthers Wardle and David Martin Makin in 1981 and is headquartered in Bury, the United Kingdom.

Mitchells & Butlers Plc engages in the business of operating managed restaurants and pubs. Its brands include Alex, All Bar One, Browns, Castle, Ego, Ember Inns, Harvester, High Street, Miller & Carter, Nicholson’s, Sirrling, O’Neill’s, Stonehouse, Pesto, Toby Carvery, Premium Country, and Vintage Inns. It operates through the United Kingdom and Germany geographical segments. The company was founded in 1898 and is headquartered in Birmingham, the United Kingdom.

Bayerische Motoren Werke AG engages in the manufacture and sale of automobiles and motorcycles. It operates through the following segments: Automotive, Motorcycles, Financial Services, and Other Entities. The Automotive segment develops, manufactures, assembles, and sells cars and off-road vehicles, under the following brands: BMW, MINI, and Rolls-Royce, as well as spare parts and accessories. The Motorcycles segment focuses on the premium segment. The Financial Services segment offers credit financing, leasing, and other services to retail customers. The Other Entities segment includes holding and group financing activities. The company was founded on March 6, 1916 and is headquartered in Munich, Germany.
